Read it now: the Task itself lasts 30 seconds

WHEN

Once a round, at its start, before the turns. The two who go cannot go again the next round.

TWO OF YOU, ONE CONTROL EACH

The game picks who runs which control. The Panel moves the crane left and right; the Winch moves the crate up and down.

THE PANEL

RELEASE sets the locking panel clicking from stop to stop along the rail, fast. LOCK stops it at the stop it rests at. Lock it at 6, over the platform. At 7 it cuts the Winch's cab.

THE WINCH

One button: Hold. Press and hold to lift the crate, and keep holding while it moves. Locked, the crate swings. Let go when it swings over the platform: it lands. Over the Panel it falls on them. Anywhere else it breaks, and the hook must fetch a new one from the hatch at 1.

THEN

Both turn a key: +5 packages for the ship.

THE TIME

30 seconds for the whole Task, the short briefing included.

MISTAKES

A late LOCK or a let-go at the wrong moment can kill. Nothing tells a mistake from a betrayal. Your press counts when it reaches the ship, a moment after you press: the stripes warn you early for that.

LEAVING

If you lose your connection for 8 seconds, the Task is cancelled. It costs you nothing more. Whatever happens, you both go back at the end of the Task's time.

How the Food Supply Task works

Read it now: the Task itself lasts 30 seconds

WHEN

Once a round, at its start, before the turns. The two who go cannot go again the next round.

TWO OF YOU, ONE CONTROL EACH

The game picks who runs which control. The Panel moves the crane left and right; the Winch moves the crate up and down.

THE PANEL

RELEASE sets the locking panel clicking from stop to stop along the rail, fast. LOCK stops it at the stop it rests at. Lock it at 6, over the platform. At 7 it cuts the Winch's cab.

THE WINCH

One button: Hold. Press and hold to lift the crate, and keep holding while it moves. Locked, the crate swings. Let go when it swings over the platform: it lands. Over the Panel it falls on them. Anywhere else it breaks, and the hook must fetch a new one from the hatch at 1.

THEN

Both turn a key: +5 packages for the ship.

THE TIME

30 seconds for the whole Task, the short briefing included.

MISTAKES

A late LOCK or a let-go at the wrong moment can kill. Nothing tells a mistake from a betrayal. Your press counts when it reaches the ship, a moment after you press: the stripes warn you early for that.

LEAVING

If you lose your connection for 8 seconds, the Task is cancelled. It costs you nothing more. Whatever happens, you both go back at the end of the Task's time.

Read it now: the Task itself lasts 30 seconds

WHEN

Once a round, at its start, before the turns. The two who go cannot go again the next round.

TWO OF YOU, ONE CONTROL EACH

The game picks who runs which control. The Panel moves the crane left and right; the Winch moves the crate up and down.

THE PANEL

RELEASE sets the locking panel clicking from stop to stop along the rail, fast. LOCK stops it at the stop it rests at. Lock it at 6, over the platform. At 7 it cuts the Winch's cab.

THE WINCH

One button: Hold. Press and hold to lift the crate, and keep holding while it moves. Locked, the crate swings. Let go when it swings over the platform: it lands. Over the Panel it falls on them. Anywhere else it breaks, and the hook must fetch a new one from the hatch at 1.

THEN

Both turn a key: +5 packages for the ship.

THE TIME

30 seconds for the whole Task, the short briefing included.

MISTAKES

A late LOCK or a let-go at the wrong moment can kill. Nothing tells a mistake from a betrayal. Your press counts when it reaches the ship, a moment after you press: the stripes warn you early for that.

LEAVING

If you lose your connection for 8 seconds, the Task is cancelled. It costs you nothing more. Whatever happens, you both go back at the end of the Task's time.

How the Food Supply Task works

Read it now: the Task itself lasts 30 seconds

WHEN

Once a round, at its start, before the turns. The two who go cannot go again the next round.

TWO OF YOU, ONE CONTROL EACH

The game picks who runs which control. The Panel moves the crane left and right; the Winch moves the crate up and down.

THE PANEL

RELEASE sets the locking panel clicking from stop to stop along the rail, fast. LOCK stops it at the stop it rests at. Lock it at 6, over the platform. At 7 it cuts the Winch's cab.

THE WINCH

One button: Hold. Press and hold to lift the crate, and keep holding while it moves. Locked, the crate swings. Let go when it swings over the platform: it lands. Over the Panel it falls on them. Anywhere else it breaks, and the hook must fetch a new one from the hatch at 1.

THEN

Both turn a key: +5 packages for the ship.

THE TIME

30 seconds for the whole Task, the short briefing included.

MISTAKES

A late LOCK or a let-go at the wrong moment can kill. Nothing tells a mistake from a betrayal. Your press counts when it reaches the ship, a moment after you press: the stripes warn you early for that.

LEAVING

If you lose your connection for 8 seconds, the Task is cancelled. It costs you nothing more. Whatever happens, you both go back at the end of the Task's time.
